description: README.md's Requirements and Install sections mirror packaging facts owned by pyproject.toml: the supported Python floor (Requirements "Python 3.11+" <-> requires-python), the PyPI distribution name and install command ("pip install tether-it" <-> [project].name), and the `tether` console command ([project.scripts]). A change to requires-python, name, or scripts in pyproject silently leaves the README prose wrong. The existing pyproject <-> tether/__init__.py tether covers the import-time version lookup, not this user-facing prose.
